reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 30 individual foil sachets, which is a lot of trash for a daily pill, and then 'no reviews' on a brand I have never heard of. The QR lab report is a nice touch, but it is not an NSF or USP seal, and my doctor told me to take magnesium, so I stay with Pure Encapsulations or Thorne.
objection: Unknown brand with zero reviews and no NSF or USP seal, packed in single-use foil packets that are wasteful. A QR code that the company itself controls does not replace a third-party certification I already trust.
would_change_my_mind: An NSF or USP certification on the box, plus a few hundred real verified reviews, and a regular bottle or refill option without the foil.
